name: Grilled buffalo
summary: The squares left after the best meat is dried. Báo Sơn La, on 2 July 2021, cuts them square, seasons them, and grills them over charcoal. A seasoning list for this plate alone was not printed. The same article’s dried meat uses ginger, garlic, chili, salt, and mắc khén.
